trust_decision.summary: Submitted form params are untrusted user data and must not be echoed into exception messages raised while building nested union forms; Form.Auto's determine_type decides which union member applies and, on failure, raises with the full inspected params.

landing_point.why: The summary names Form.Auto and the unknown _union_type error; that raise is the only place the message text 'Got "_union_type" parameter' appears.

fix_sites.entry_point: AshPhoenix.Form.add_form/3, validate/3, for_create/for_update/for_action with params: (all reach the union updater via AshPhoenix.Form.update_opts, lib/ash_phoenix/form/form.ex:4064-4075)
same as above; params lacking _union_type and matching no tag
new helper union_type_names/1 (also stops printing full constraints)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both published sites are in one function family in lib/ash_phoenix/form/auto.ex; the second (no-_union_type / tag mismatch) clause at lib/ash_phoenix/form/auto.ex:299-319 is a sibling clause, not an out-of-scope module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The _form_type raise in form.ex is not about unions or Form.Auto, triggers on a framework-internal hidden field, and could be argued a developer-misuse error rather than a user-facing one.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The error must still name the offending _union_type value and list the available type names (the fix's test asserts the value is still present), and valid _union_type/tag selection must keep building the right nested form; removing the raise or swallowing the error would break type selection diagnostics.

params map with no "_union_type" (or atom-keyed) where no tag/tag_value matches (lib/ash_phoenix/form/auto.ex:299-319)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Nested single form with params and no data whose _form_type is anything other than create/read raises with inspect(form_params), echoing all submitted nested params.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different module (Form, not Form.Auto), not union-related, keyed on an internal hidden field; looks like a developer-error path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the non-map params warning extended to include inspect(params)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A debugging-friendly maintainer would add the offending value to the warning; it is the natural next edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the Ash.Union data clauses raising on an unknown type with inspect(data/params) instead of crashing on nil config
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same function family; a maintainer hardening nil config would reuse the existing verbose message template.
